newsitem.title: INDIA: No move to merge bank, says India ICICI.
newsitem.headline: No move to merge bank, says India ICICI.

text.p: Term-lending bank Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India Ltd (ICICI) said on Tuesday it had not initiated any steps to merge with ICICI Banking Corp.
ICICI Banking Corp's initial public offer is opening today.
"ICICI has neither initiated any steps towards becoming a bank nor considered a merger of any sort with ICICI Bank," ICICI said in a statement.
ICICI Banking Corp is a subsidiary of ICICI.

"The matter has not been discussed by the boards of the respective organisations, nor have any steps been initiated with the Reserve Bank of India, consequently there is no question of disclosure in the offer document," it said.

The Economic Times on Tuesday said the market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India was looking into the fact that ICICI Banking Corp's offer document is silent about its parent firm's merger plan.
